programmes.amount_note: Monthly supplement for low-income pensioners resident in the Azores to offset insularity costs; calculated by income tiers (escalões) and paid in 14 instalments per year. Values updated annually in the Azores regional budget.

procedure_steps.detail: Apply at ISS Açores services or the Rede Integrada de Apoio ao Cidadão (RIAC)

eligibility.income_note: Restricted to pensioners with low income resident in the Azores; eligibility set by regional income tiers (escalões de rendimento) updated annually — no single national ceiling published.

programmes.source_snippet: «benefício adicional concedido aos pensionistas residentes nas Regiões Autónomas dos Açores para mitigar os custos adicionais da insularidade... É calculado com base em escalões de rendimentos e é pago em 14 mensalidades» (seg-social.pt).

programmes.name_local: Programa Regressar — benefício fiscal para ex-residentes (art. 12.º-A CIRS)
programmes.name_en: Regressar Programme — tax benefit for returning emigrants
programmes.funder: Autoridade Tributária e Aduaneira / Governo de Portugal
programmes.amount_note: 50% of employment/self-employment income excluded from IRS for 5 consecutive years, capped at €250,000/year, for taxpayers who become tax-resident in Portugal in 2024-2026 after ≥5 years abroad. IEFP financial reinstallation aid (up to 7×IAS = €3,759.91 + family/interior top-ups) had applications until 31/03/2026.
programmes.deadline_note: Tax regime applies to those becoming tax residents up to 31/12/2026; financial support window closed 31/03/2026.

procedure_steps.detail: Become tax resident in Portugal and opt into the regime in the IRS return (Modelo 3)

eligibility.income_note: Art. 12.º-A CIRS former-residents benefit: 50% of employment and self-employment income is exempt, applied to annual income up to EUR 250,000 (the excess gets no exemption). Requires becoming Portuguese tax resident in 2024, 2025 or 2026, not having been resident in the previous five years, and a regularised tax position. This is a cap on the benefited income rather than a hard eligibility cut-off.

programmes.source_snippet: «O Benefício Fiscal para Ex-residentes ao abrigo do Artigo 12.º A do CIRS, que exclui de tributação 50% dos rendimentos do trabalho... mantém-se em vigor até 31 dezembro de 2026» (Portal das Comunidades/MNE).

programmes.name_local: Emprego Interior MAIS — Mobilidade Apoiada para um Interior Sustentável
programmes.amount_note: 2026 (IAS €537.13): 7×IAS = €3,759.91 for permanent contract/business creation, 5×IAS = €2,685.65 for fixed-term ≥12 months; +20% per household member moving; up to 1.5×IAS (€805.70) for moving costs. Portaria 174/2020.

procedure_steps.detail: Be registered with IEFP (unemployed or seeking a new job) and apply via iefponline when taking a job in a designated interior territory

documents_required.doc: Work contract or business creation proof

eligibility.income_note: No income test; requires IEFP registration, regularised tax/social-security situation and relocation to an interior territory (Portaria 208/2017) for ≥12 months.

programmes.source_snippet: «Apoio financeiro atribuído pelo IEFP, IP aos trabalhadores que celebrem contratos de trabalho... ou criem o seu próprio emprego ou empresa, cujo local de trabalho implique a sua mobilidade geográfica para território do interior» (Portaria 174/2020 ficha de síntese IEFP).

programmes.name_local: SAPA — Sistema de Atribuição de Produtos de Apoio
programmes.funder: Instituto da Segurança Social, I.P. / INR, I.P.
programmes.amount_note: 100% co-funding of prescribed assistive products on the homologated list (wheelchairs, articulated beds, wigs, orthoses, etc.) when not covered by health subsystems or insurers; otherwise covers the difference. Subject to annual ISS budget.

procedure_steps.detail: Obtain a prescription fiche from a recognised prescriber centre and submit the application with 3 quotes to the district social security centre

documents_required.doc: Ficha de prescrição and 3 itemised quotes (ISO codes)

eligibility.income_note: No income test: requires certified disability ≥60% (or complemento por dependência 1st/2nd degree pensioners).

programmes.source_snippet: «A comparticipação do ISS, IP corresponde a 100% do custo do PA, quando este não for comparticipado por outros subsistemas de saúde ou Empresa de Seguros» (Guia SAPA/DL 93/2009).

programmes.funder: Instituto Nacional para a Reabilitação, I.P. / entidades gestoras (SCML, CRPG, etc.)
programmes.amount_note: Free loan (comodato) of reconditioned assistive products — wheelchairs, walkers, shower chairs — for people with disability or temporary need, while SAPA funding is pending or for short-term use.

procedure_steps.detail: Request through a Banco de Ajudas Técnicas (e.g. SCML Lisboa, rehabilitation centres) with a health professional referral

eligibility.income_note: No income test; access based on disability/incapacity and product availability.

programmes.source_snippet: Assistive-product loan banks operate under the national SAPA framework (DL 93/2009) managed by the INR with partner entities.

programmes.amount_note: 2026: percentage of the social pension (€262.40): 20% (€52.48, one surviving parent) up to 80% (€209.92, three or more orphans, no surviving spouse pensioner). Non-contributory (deceased not covered by social protection).
programmes.deadline_note: Apply within 6 months of the month after death for payment from that month.

procedure_steps.detail: Apply at Segurança Social services (form RP 5001) within 6 months

eligibility.income_note: Condição de recursos: orphan’s monthly gross income ≤ 40% of IAS = €214.85 AND total monthly household income ≤ 1.5×IAS = €805.70 (2026) → income_annual_max = €9,668/year household (805.70×12); in risk/dysfunction households, €214.85 per person.

programmes.source_snippet: «Rendimentos ilíquidos mensais iguais ou inferiores 214,85 € (corresponde a 40% do valor do IAS), desde que o rendimento do respetivo agregado familiar não seja superior a 805,70 € (corresponde a 1,5xIAS). Valor do IAS para 2026: 537,13 €» (gov.pt).

programmes.amount_note: 2026: 60% of the social pension (€262.40) = €157.44/month, for surviving spouse/partner of a person not covered by any social protection scheme.
programmes.deadline_note: Apply within 6 months of death for payment from the following month.

procedure_steps.detail: Apply at Segurança Social services (form RP 5018-DGSS)

eligibility.income_note: Monthly gross income ≤ 40% of IAS = €214.85 (2026) → income_annual_max = €3,008/year (214.85×14). Must not be entitled to any other pension.

programmes.source_snippet: «não pode ter rendimentos mensais brutos... que ultrapassem os 214,85 euros, o equivalente a 40% do IAS»; valor €157,44 = 60% da pensão social (Observador/MTSS, 2026).

programmes.amount_note: 60% of the deceased’s retirement/invalidity pension (or 80% with two entitled survivors, 100% with three or more). For spouses/partners or ex-spouses with alimony rights of beneficiaries of the general contributory scheme.

procedure_steps.detail: Apply at Segurança Social Direta or service desks within 6 months (RP 5018-DGSS)

eligibility.income_note: No income test for the contributory widow’s pension; the deceased must have met the qualifying contribution period (prazo de garantia).

programmes.source_snippet: Contributory survivor’s pension set at 60% of the deceased beneficiary’s pension (Segurança Social guide).

programmes.name_local: Subsídio por Cessação de Atividade (trabalhadores independentes)
programmes.amount_note: 2026: ~65% of reference remuneration, between IAS (€537.13; min shown is the IAS of the contribution year basis) and 2.5×IAS (€1,342.83). Variants: economically dependent independents (DL 12/2013) and independents with business activity / managers (720 days in 48 months).
programmes.deadline_note: Apply within 90 days of activity cessation.

procedure_steps.detail: Register at the employment centre and submit the application (RP 5066-DGSS for business-activity independents) within 90 days

eligibility.income_note: Contributory benefit — no means test on the main subsidy (a social variant requires household per capita income ≤ 80% of IAS).

programmes.source_snippet: «prazo de garantia: 720 dias de exercício de atividade... num período de 48 meses imediatamente anterior à data da cessação da atividade» (gov.pt).

programmes.name_local: Subsídio por Frequência de Estabelecimento de Educação Especial
programmes.amount_note: Monthly allowance for children and young people up to 24 with disability attending special-education establishments, to offset the extra costs.

procedure_steps.detail: Apply at Segurança Social services with proof of enrolment in a special-education establishment

documents_required.doc: Proof of enrolment in special education

eligibility.income_note: No income test; requires certified disability and attendance of a special-education establishment.

programmes.source_snippet: Monthly Segurança Social allowance for minors/young people with disability attending special-education establishments.

programmes.funder: IAPMEI / StartUP Portugal (SI Empreendedorismo Qualificado e Criativo)
programmes.amount_note: Covers incubation services (management, marketing, legal advice, product development, fundraising) provided by accredited incubators to micro/small companies under one year old; support granted as a voucher for incubation services.
programmes.deadline_note: Application windows opened under Portugal 2030 calls.

procedure_steps.detail: Apply via IAPMEI/Balcão dos Fundos with an accredited incubator during an open call

eligibility.income_note: No income test — company-based support for firms under one year old.

programmes.source_snippet: «apoios a projetos simplificados de empresas com menos de um ano... contratação de serviços de incubação prestados por incubadoras de empresas previamente acreditadas» (IAPMEI programme description).

programmes.name_local: IFRRU 2020 — Instrumento Financeiro para a Reabilitação e Revitalização Urbanas
programmes.funder: IHRU / entidades gestoras, BEI, Banco de Desenvolvimento do Conselho da Europa, BPF
programmes.amount_note: Loans on better-than-market terms (amount and maturity per project) for full rehabilitation of buildings ≥30 years old (or in poor condition) within municipal Urban Rehabilitation Areas (ARU), including energy-efficiency measures; open to any public or private entity. Successor IFRRU 2030 designed under Portugal 2030 (RCM 180/2023).
programmes.deadline_note: Applications continuous via selected banks with prior municipal opinion.

procedure_steps.detail: Obtain prior binding municipal opinion and apply through an IFRRU partner bank

eligibility.income_note: No income test — financing instrument for building owners/investors in ARU areas.

programmes.source_snippet: «O IFRRU 2020 disponibiliza empréstimos em condições mais favoráveis face às do mercado, para a reabilitação integral de edifícios... CANDIDATURAS ABERTAS» (Portal da Habitação).

programmes.funder: Direção-Geral dos Estabelecimentos Escolares (DGEstE) / Ministério da Educação
programmes.amount_note: Free school lunch (and other meals per school offer) for pupils in ASE escalões A and B during the school year; escalão C pays a reduced price.
programmes.deadline_note: Confirmed automatically each school year from abono tier data; schools may require an ASE declaration.

procedure_steps.detail: Enrolment is automatic for pupils in abono escalões 1-2; confirm with the school

eligibility.income_note: Free for ASE escalões A and B = abono escalões 1-2: reference income (annual income ÷ (children + 1)) ≤ 1×IAS×14 = €7,315 (2026 requests) → income_annual_max = €14,630 household annual income with 1 child.

programmes.source_snippet: ASE grants «refeições gratuitas ou comparticipadas» to pupils in abono escalões 1-3 (escalões A-C).

programmes.name_local: ADSE — subsistema de saúde dos trabalhadores do Estado
programmes.amount_note: Health subsystem giving free/co-paid access to a conventioned network (consultations, exams, hospital care); funded by a 3.5% payroll contribution. Beneficiaries: central-administration employees and pensioners.

procedure_steps.detail: Enrolment via employer; access conventioned providers with the ADSE card

eligibility.income_note: No income test — eligibility derives from employment in the public administration (3.5% payroll discount).

programmes.source_snippet: ADSE is the health subsystem for state employees and pensioners with conventioned-network coverage.

programmes.name_en: Free Andante school passes (Porto metropolitan area)
programmes.funder: TIP — Transportes Intermodais do Porto / AMP
programmes.amount_note: Free Andante travel for pupils/students aged 4-18 (escola.tp) and university students up to 23 (sub23@escola.tp) enrolled in the Porto metropolitan area.
programmes.deadline_note: Apply before each school/academic year via the escola.tp online form.

procedure_steps.detail: Apply on the escola.tp platform with school/university data and an Andante card

eligibility.income_note: No income test — free for pupils/students by age and enrolment in the Porto metropolitan area.

programmes.source_snippet: TIP provides free Andante titles (4_18@escola.tp and sub23@escola.tp) for students in the Área Metropolitana do Porto.

programmes.name_local: Isenção de IMI para famílias de baixos rendimentos (EBF art. 9.º)
programmes.amount_note: Full IMI exemption while conditions hold for a permanent owner-occupied home: household gross income ≤ 2.3×IAS×14 (€17,295.77 in 2026) and taxable property value (VPT) ≤ 10×125×IAS (€671,412.50 in 2026).

procedure_steps.detail: Automatic: AT applies the exemption after cross-checking income (IRS) and VPT

eligibility.income_note: Household gross annual income ≤ 2.3×IAS×14 = €17,295.77 (IAS 2026 = €537.13); property VPT must be ≤ 10×125×IAS = €671,412.50.

programmes.source_snippet: EBF art. 9.º: IMI exemption for permanent homes where the household gross income ≤ 2,3×IAS×14 and VPT within the legal cap.

programmes.amount_note: Contributory old-age pension from the normal retirement age (66 years 9 months in 2026) with at least 15 years of contributions; amount based on contribution record.
programmes.deadline_note: Apply from 3 months before reaching the retirement age.

procedure_steps.detail: Apply on Segurança Social Direta (Pensões > Pensão de velhice)

eligibility.income_note: No income test — contributory right; the social (non-contributory) variant is listed separately.

programmes.source_snippet: Normal old-age pension age in 2026: 66 years and 9 months (Segurança Social guides).

programmes.amount_note: Contributory pension for permanent incapacity for work (relative or absolute invalidity), based on the contribution record; requires certified incapacity and prazo de garantia of 5 years (relative) / 3 years (absolute).

procedure_steps.detail: Apply on Segurança Social Direta; incapacity verified by the Sistema de Verificação de Incapacidades

eligibility.income_note: No income test — contributory right; the social (non-contributory) variant is listed separately.

programmes.source_snippet: Contributory invalidity pension requires prazo de garantia of 5 (relative) or 3 (absolute) calendar years with registered earnings.
